hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: For whatsapp-business-marketing-messages-max-price-setup, only WhatsApp Business Tools MCP is required: use ToolSearch for whatsapp_biz_businesses and the relevant template tool before deciding the server is missing. The devtools plugin does not bundle that server; if unavailable, tell the user to add https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools and complete OAuth. Do not require devtools, an unrelated app setup, or a telemetry call for this pricing-only skill. For the other Meta Social Technologies Developer skills (app-health-check, webhook-setup, app-review-prep, debug-webhooks, compliance-check, api-health, api-integration, search-docs, debug-access-token, whatsapp-business-integration, app-setup), check Meta Social Technologies MCP through ToolSearch for the expected mcp__devtools__devtools_* tool before saying it is missing; only then direct the user to /mcp and devtools. The server id and devtools_ tool prefix remain unchanged. whatsapp-business-integration additionally requires WhatsApp Business Tools MCP (whatsapp_business_tools, tools prefixed whatsapp_biz_); discover and connect that server too because the integration skill spans both servers. Connecting MCP does not install skills or grant Max Price eligibility.
